cases.title: Clean round line is unchanged
steps: Run a fake run with no script as TESTING.md describes, in tmux or with --web
cases.expected: The log contains 'code review round 0: 0 blocker, 0 major, 0 minor' with no '(… fixed)' suffix

cases.title: Fixed findings are not counted as open
steps: Write a fake script: reviewer:code-r0 reports one blocker (id F1, file 1.txt, line 1, failureScenario set, status open); reviewer:code-r1 reports the same finding with status fixed
Run the diamond fixture with --provider fake and that script as TESTING.md describes
cases.expected: The log contains 'code review round 1: 0 blocker, 0 major, 0 minor (1 fixed)' and the run exits 0

cases.title: End-of-run table counts only open findings
steps: Run the same scripted run as P2 in the terminal UI (tmux, TESTING.md)
Read the final summary's findings table
cases.expected: The code review row shows 0 in every severity column
